description: Skeleton system whose placeholders share the real page layout
acceptance: Every data route streams a skeleton that matches its loaded layout, with no perceptible layout shift on a slow connection
evidence: Shared containers in apps/web/features/shell/pageLayout.ts imported by both pages and skeletons; 19 skeletons, 34 route loading.tsx files; home moved into app/(storefront) so the root fallback no longer covered other routes (43fec2c); Playwright 42030526892 passed on the deployment, asserting each route's own skeleton in the streamed HTML for /, /catalog, /help, /journal, a product and a store, holding CLS under 0.05 on a throttled connection, and capturing 12 screenshots

description: Content management for the homepage and the Help Center and Journal copy
acceptance: An editor changes the homepage hero in /admin/cms and the public homepage updates within 60s without redeploy; a Playwright test proves it
evidence: cms_sections and cms_section_versions store bilingual hero, collection and banner sections with status, schedule, order, last-10 versions and a revalidated public homepage (5d3d819); the client list needed a strings-only copy object because the admin dictionary carries a function (a5b492f). Site settings (0387cec) add one versioned site_settings record for the announcement bar, header and footer links, metadata defaults and the bilingual shipping and return text, read once in the root layout and published at /policies; the link schema now accepts a label in one language, since localisedLinks already falls back (c41dab8). Playwright 42057524731 passed 26 checks on the deployment: it renamed the hero in /admin/cms/sections and saw it on / within 60s, switched the announcement on, followed its link to /policies, added and removed a footer link, and checked the CMS routes at 375, 768 and 1440px. The Help Center and Journal slices are still to come.
